lines.zh: 我一步下去，树都矮了半截。
lines.en: One step of mine and the trees drop half a length.

lines.zh: 巨大的身躯慢慢地碾过林地。
lines.en: My vast bulk grinds across the woodland.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，地面留下沟。
lines.en: I leave a furrow wherever I pass.

lines.zh: 七颗龙珠的气，在我身上绕。
lines.en: The aura of seven dragon balls coils around me.

lines.zh: 我抬起腿，阴影先盖住你。
lines.en: I lift a leg; my shadow covers you first.
I don't go around; I go through.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫倒一排树，像割麦子。
lines.en: My tail mows a row of trees like wheat.

lines.zh: 我缓慢地转身，整片林子都在响。
lines.en: I turn slowly and the whole wood creaks.

lines.zh: 我踩碎石头，声音很远都听得见。
lines.en: I crush stone underfoot; the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 我从山谷走进盆地，气势不减。
lines.en: I come down from the valley into the basin, undiminished.

lines.zh: 我离地不高，但每一步都震。
lines.en: I don't rise far, but every step quakes.

lines.zh: 我磨着爪子，往你的方向走。
lines.en: I scrape my claws and walk your way.

lines.zh: 我立着，像一座会呼吸的山。
lines.en: I stand like a breathing mountain.

lines.zh: 七颗星的光在我身上游走。
lines.en: The light of seven stars wanders over me.
I wait for you to dare come near.

lines.zh: 这点小虫子，还不够塞牙。
lines.en: These little bugs aren't even a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收了收，怕碰坏树。
lines.en: I fold my wings so I won't break the trees.

lines.zh: 身上的旧伤在隐隐作响。
lines.en: My old wounds creak faintly.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你像粒石子。
lines.en: I look down at you: a pebble.
My claws are wider than a door.
They sealed me away for a long time.
I smell dragon balls.

lines.zh: 我抬爪，地面跟着抬了一下。
lines.en: I raise a claw and the ground rises with it.

lines.zh: 这么矮的世界，我一步就到边。
lines.en: Such a low world; one step reaches its edge.
I'm in no hurry. I never am.
Your ki is thin as thread.

lines.zh: 我把脸低下，好让你看清。
lines.en: I lower my face so you can see it.

lines.zh: 七星龙这么大，你还没我手掌大。
lines.en: Seven-Star Dragon this big — you're smaller than my palm.
Standing your ground — that's nerve.

lines.zh: 我说话的时候，地都在抖。
lines.en: When I speak, the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 你那点力气，打不穿我的皮。
lines.en: Your strength won't pierce my hide.
I have tasted your ki already.
I don't dislike that light in your eyes.
Don't tense up; I don't eat people.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，像在打量虫子。
lines.en: I tilt my head, studying a bug.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑，够我剔牙吗？
lines.en: Is that sword enough to pick my teeth?
If we fight, stand in the open.
It's cool in my shadow.
You carry the scent of a dragon ball.

lines.zh: 我从你眼睛里看见我自己。
lines.en: I see myself in your eyes.
You haven't run. Good.
Give your name; my memory is good.
That stung, little thing.
A pale mark is left on my hide.
A wound like this heals in a few centuries.

lines.zh: 这一击擦过鳞片，我低吼。
lines.en: The blow grazes my scales, and I growl.
My blood drips and pits the soil.
I shake myself and the mountain rings.
An old wound has been pulled.

lines.zh: 这点伤，离变身还差得远。
lines.en: This much damage is nowhere near what makes me change.
I don't eat anything that small.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我连低头都懒。
lines.en: You hold it up; I can't be bothered to lower my head.

lines.zh: 这点食物，填不了我的牙缝。
lines.en: That wouldn't fill the gap in my teeth.
Your dragon-coaxing skills are poor.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只想活动一下。
lines.en: I'm not hungry; I just want to stretch.
Eat it yourself, human.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，鼻孔喷出热气。
lines.en: I sniff and my nostrils vent hot air.
Take it away before I step on it.

lines.zh: 在我的尺寸面前，这不算什么。
lines.en: At my scale, that's nothing.

lines.zh: 我笑了一声，树上的鸟都飞了。
lines.en: I laugh once and the birds scatter.
You hit me like hitting a cliff.
I didn't move a toe.
You're the one who bounces off.
My hide is harder than you'd guess.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的爪，赶紧缩回去。
lines.en: You step on my claw and snatch your foot back.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼，没什么。
lines.en: I look down once. Nothing.
My weight rolls you away.

lines.zh: 这么大的我，走路总会碰到东西。
lines.en: Being this big, I bump into things.
Make way, or it will hurt.
Only after you back off do I lift my foot.
Another great dragon is nearby.

lines.zh: 我们隔得很远，也感觉得到。
lines.en: We sense each other from far off.
Our kind speak in low growls.

lines.zh: 它比我小一号，气却很足。
lines.en: It's a size smaller, but its aura is strong.

lines.zh: 七颗星的光在我们之间连起来。
lines.en: The seven-star light links between us.

lines.zh: 它挪过来的那下，地裂了。
lines.en: The ground cracked when it shifted over.
No need for words. We understand.
We part; each returns to its valley.

lines.zh: 下次醒来，也许又是几百年。
lines.en: Next we wake, centuries may have passed.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我一爪就能抓起。
lines.en: I can scoop up anything with one claw.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，整片林子都动了。
lines.en: I bend, and the whole wood moves.
A pearl is a grain of sand in my palm.
I pinch it up, inspect it, and keep it.
I keep these little things for amusement.

lines.zh: 我捡起铁块，像捡起一叶草。
lines.en: I lift the iron like a leaf.
Mortals' lost things are mine.
I tuck it into a gap in my scales.

lines.zh: 再小的东西，我也看得见。
lines.en: However small, I see it.
Time for me to collect.
You're standing in my shadow now.
I lower my head and put you in view.
Ki gathers at my jaws.
You shouldn't have let me see you.
One palm of mine will sink the earth.

lines.zh: 你后退也没用，我的手臂很长。
lines.en: Backing away won't help; my arm is long.
Locked on, little dragon-ball carrier.
Let's test your nerve first.
Let's see how many you can dodge.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经绕到你后头。
lines.en: My tail has already come around behind you.

lines.zh: 五格高的身子，一步就够到你。
lines.en: At five blocks tall, one stride reaches you.
I've sniffed out where you are.
Don't run; it spoils the fun.
I move first. Suit yourself.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在我耳里很响。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud in my ears.

lines.zh: 你跑到树后，我一掌拍平。
lines.en: You hide behind trees; I flatten them.

lines.zh: 我一直看着，你逃不出这片谷。
lines.en: I keep watching. You can't leave this valley.
You move; I calculate where you'll land.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑暗里也亮。
lines.en: My eyes shine even in darkness.

lines.zh: 你越躲越深，我越走越近。
lines.en: The deeper you hide, the closer I come.

lines.zh: 我不急，我一步顶你十步。
lines.en: No hurry: one step of mine is ten of yours.
Your aura is leaking out.
I draw it in. Just like that.

lines.zh: 七星龙的影子跟着你转。
lines.en: The seven-star dragon's shadow turns with you.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶过去，风把你压倒。
lines.en: I pass overhead and the wind flattens you.

lines.zh: 你的箭钉在我皮上，像刺。
lines.en: Your arrows are thorns in my hide.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把天上的光遮了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and blot out the light.
You have a few steps left to run.
I wait for your strength to run out.
Your footsteps grow fainter.

lines.zh: 我压过来，像一面移动的墙。
lines.en: I press in like a moving wall.

lines.zh: 你躲在石头后，那石头不够大。
lines.en: That rock isn't big enough.
My tail has closed the circle.

lines.zh: 一掌落下，地面整块塌了。
lines.en: One palm falls; a whole slab of ground sinks.
A ki blast erupts from my jaws.
One claw tears your guard open.
My tail sweeps; you go flying.
This blow can split bedrock.
I stomp; all you can do is roll.
You blocked the claw, not the ki.

lines.zh: 七星龙的影子盖住整片地。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole field.
The shockwave throws you ten paces.
I haven't used half my strength.

lines.zh: 你身上裂了条缝，声音真脆。
lines.en: Something on you cracks. Such a crisp sound.
I raise the other hand.
That should teach you to retreat.

lines.zh: 你被砸进土里，只露出肩。
lines.en: You're driven into the soil, only your shoulders showing.
When I pull back, the wind still rings.
I rise out of a split in the earth.

lines.zh: 七颗星的光聚成一具身体。
lines.en: The light of seven stars gathers into a body.
The mountain moves because I am rising.
I open my eyes and the sky dims a shade.
It's been a long time since I stood.
I land and every tree bends.

lines.zh: 这么大的世界，谁来挡我？
lines.en: Such a vast world — who will stand in my way?

lines.zh: 我拍掉身上的土，像拍掉雪。
lines.en: I brush the earth off like snow.
Seven dragon balls, not one missing.

lines.zh: 我先吼了一声，山谷回声很久。
lines.en: I roar first; the valley echoes long.

lines.zh: 我从封印里走出来，关节作响。
lines.en: I walk out of the seal, joints creaking.
This patch of ground will hold me.
The clouds are pushed apart by my aura.

lines.zh: 我低头，看清了这个世界。
lines.en: I look down and take in this world.

lines.zh: 这么大的我，走过来花了不少时间。
lines.en: Being this large, it took time to arrive.

lines.zh: 谁把我放出来了？我要谢他。
lines.en: Who freed me? I'd like to thank them.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过整条河，才站稳。
lines.en: One stride clears the whole river before I settle.

lines.zh: 睁开眼第一件事，是找天空。
lines.en: The first thing on waking is to look for the sky.

lines.zh: 火苗在我皮上跳，像落叶。
lines.en: Flames dance on my hide like falling leaves.

lines.zh: 落地时我的骨头闷响了一声。
lines.en: My bones thud once on landing.
I sink, and the water only reaches my waist.

lines.zh: 爆开的火光，在我眼前一闪。
lines.en: A burst of firelight flashes before my eyes.

lines.zh: 陌生的力量缠住我的爪。
lines.en: Strange power binds my claws.
It's been too long since I ate.
Lightning rolls down my back.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，我一直在落。
lines.en: No ground in the void; I keep falling.
